title: Rabbah bar Lima
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Rosh Hashanah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.4a.6) and [Megillah 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.13b.7), Rabbah bar Lima speaks in Rav’s name. Hyman reports that Sefer Yuchasin gives R’ Abba bar Lima.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Megillah places the attribution to Rav in parentheses. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=78&lang=en) has a separate entry for Abba bar Lima.
